text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFe-OER-baseline-refine-v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"Confirm current plate before routine NiFe baseline refinement."},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,-5,0,45,0,0,0,60,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Standard NiFe-rich OER baseline with a Co trim; normalized vector, sum=100, nominal thickness."},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":350,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"Routine low-temperature anneal within standard FTO window."},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,-5,0,45,0,0,0,60,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"Chronopotentiometry at default acquisition rate for baseline OER overpotential."},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"Ingest baseline CP result into the surrogate model."},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,-5,0,45,0,0,0,60,0,0,0,0],"duration":2},"comment":"Short 2 h stability check on the same normalized baseline composition."}]}
